'''Heptalia''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|34|Heptalia}}</ref> located in the [[Heptalia system/Legends|Heptalia system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="TEA Heptalia" /> the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Heptalia's artisans produced furniture coverings and embroidered rugs that were considered to be exquisite and lent renown to the planet.<ref name="CSWE" />

[[Shula Shevu|Shula Pakasj]], an employee of [[GalactiSend]] on the<ref name="Revelation" /> [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], owned a [[Heptalian embroidered throw]]<ref name="Revelation" /> by [[41 ABY]]<ref name="Date">[[Shula Shevu|Shula Pakasj's]] [[Heptalian embroidered throw]] is mentioned in ''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]'', the events of which are dated to [[41 ABY]] by ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> and kept it at her [[Gender/Legends|boyfriend]] [[Lon Shevu]]'s [[Lon Shevu's apartment|Coruscant apartment]].<ref name="Revelation" />

==Behind the scenes==
Heptalia was introduced in the [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="CSWE" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed Heptalia in grid square M-14.<ref name="TEA Heptalia" />
